Full of character and classic prewar charm, this spacious one-bedroom apartment offers a comfortable layout with beautiful architectural details throughout. Elegant archways, built-in bookshelf and French doors add warmth and character, while hardwood floors, high ceilings, and generous room proportions create an inviting living space.

The apartment features a spacious living room, a separate eat-in kitchen with ample cabinetry, and a generously sized bedroom with great closet space. Original details and thoughtful design elements give the home a timeless appeal.

The apartment is located on the second floor of a beautiful, well-maintained building, which has 2 elevators. There is also a shared laundry room in the lower level of the building.

Conveniently located in prime Bensonhurst near multiple restaurants along 86th St and Bay Parkway, all major banks, a 24hr Fitness as well as Planet Fitness, pharmacies, and other shopping. The building is also only a few short blocks away from the D train and walking distance to the express bus to Manhattan and Bensonhurst Park, known for its scenic waterfront views, peaceful walking paths, and spectacular sunsets.
